question: Review the C-7 context-management study's architecture recommendation before it is treated as settled: is the no-RAG, repo-native governed-context-map direction correct for EOS, or does a mechanism exist that beats grep+index for THIS bounded governance corpus without introducing a second authority?
claudePosition: EOS already provides 7/8 required properties; the genuine gap is a governed CONTEXT MAP + retrieval policy, not storage or a retrieval engine. Recommend: small repo-native BUILD (context-map.json + per-domain README index + Context Health lint + context-package generator) over heavy REUSE (Git · grep · existing freshnessState/reviewProvenance · roadmap model + ledgers · Agent Skills as L0 · context packets); ADOPT front-matter governance envelope + ADR/MADR status lifecycle + llms.txt-style index; INTEGRATE CODEOWNERS + Actions validator + MCP Resources (cautiously) + Aider repo-map (optional). NOT BUILD vector DB/embeddings/semantic search/knowledge graph/second authority/standing server/managed RAG. Two routed research streams converge (grep beats embeddings for small structured corpora; Sourcegraph dropped embeddings-as-primary); load-bearing finding: machine-auto-summarized context files measurably hurt agent success (ETH Zurich) → narrative content stays human/governed-authored.
chatgptPosition: CONCUR_WITH_CORRECTION. Core repo-native no-RAG architecture concurred (do not build vector DB/embeddings/semantic search/knowledge graph/2nd authority/standing server/managed RAG for the current bounded corpus). 8 corrections: (C1) add CANONICALITY/PRECEDENCE + EFFECTIVE APPLICABILITY to the schema; (C2) map = pointers + governance metadata colocated with the artifact, generated/validated, never a 2nd copy; (C3) MCP strengthened to INTEGRATE/future delivery interface (2026-07-28 spec) but not an authority/dependency; (C4) llms.txt optional export only; (C5) Context Health captures usage evidence; (C6) negative retrieval first-class (measure unnecessary-loaded too); (C7) reproducible context package (extends #747); (C8) wrong-granularity failure mode → retrieve-don't-guess escalation. Evidence-triggered escalation for semantic retrieval; keep EOS context provider-neutral. No unresolved strategic tradeoff requiring Owner judgment before Design; route to Design; implementation may proceed per the established governance boundary after Design disposition.
conclusion: Repo-native governed context map architecture accepted with 8 corrections (all incorporated into the study §12); no-duplication verified; no unresolved strategic tradeoff. DESIGN COMPLETE. Implementation gated only on the Owner moving from research+design-only into an implementation phase (repo-safe).
responsibility: ChatGPT (architecture/governance/build-vs-buy review) → Claude consumes the response; Design/Owner disposition gates any implementation.
ownerRequirement: Independent Claude analysis first, then ChatGPT comparison; resolve disagreement by evidence; only unresolved strategic tradeoffs reach the Owner.
